title: Inside the Mind of a Master Procrastinator | Tim Urban | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】拖延症大師的內心世界提姆厄本 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: So in college, I was a government major,
cues.en: So in college, I was a government major,
cues.zh: 所以在大學我學的是政府專業

cues.text: which means I had to write a lot of papers.
cues.en: which means I had to write a lot of papers.
cues.zh: 這意味著我必須寫很多論文。

cues.text: Now, when a normal student writes a paper, they might spread the work out a little like this.
cues.en: Now, when a normal student writes a paper, they might spread the work out a little like this.
cues.zh: 現在，當一個普通學生寫論文時，他們可能會像這樣展開工作。

cues.text: So, you know -- you get started maybe a little slowly,
cues.en: So, you know -- you get started maybe a little slowly,
cues.zh: 所以，你知道——你開始可能會有點慢，

cues.text: but you get enough done in the first week that, with some heavier days later on,
cues.en: but you get enough done in the first week that, with some heavier days later on,
cues.zh: 但你在第一週就完成了足夠的工作，在接下來的幾天裡，

cues.text: everything gets done, things stay civil.
cues.en: everything gets done, things stay civil.
cues.zh: 一切都完成了，一切都保持文明。

cues.text: And I would want to do that like that.
cues.en: And I would want to do that like that.
cues.zh: 我也想那樣做。

cues.text: That would be the plan.
cues.en: That would be the plan.
cues.zh: 這就是計劃。

cues.text: I would have it all ready to go, but then, actually, the paper would come along,
cues.en: I would have it all ready to go, but then, actually, the paper would come along,
cues.zh: 我會把一切都準備好，但實際上，報紙會出現，

cues.text: and then I would kind of do this.
cues.en: and then I would kind of do this.
cues.zh: 然後我會這樣做。

cues.text: And that would happen every single paper.
cues.en: And that would happen every single paper.
cues.zh: 每一篇論文都會發生這種情況。

cues.text: But then came my 90-page senior thesis, a paper you're supposed to spend a year on.
cues.en: But then came my 90-page senior thesis, a paper you're supposed to spend a year on.
cues.zh: 但接下來是我 90 頁的高階論文，你應該花一年的時間完成這篇論文。

cues.text: And I knew for a paper like that, my normal work flow was not an option.
cues.en: And I knew for a paper like that, my normal work flow was not an option.
cues.zh: 我知道對於這樣的論文，我的正常工作流程不是一個選擇。

cues.text: It was way too big a project.
cues.en: It was way too big a project.
cues.zh: 這是一個太大的工程。

cues.text: So I planned things out, and I decided I kind of had to go something like this.
cues.en: So I planned things out, and I decided I kind of had to go something like this.
cues.zh: 所以我計劃好了事情，我決定我必須這樣做。

cues.text: This is how the year would go.
cues.en: This is how the year would go.
cues.zh: 這一年就這樣過去了。

cues.text: So I'd start off light, and I'd bump it up in the middle months,
cues.en: So I'd start off light, and I'd bump it up in the middle months,
cues.zh: 所以我會從輕的開始，然後在中間的幾個月加大力度，

cues.text: and then at the end, I would kick it up into high gear just like a little staircase.
cues.en: and then at the end, I would kick it up into high gear just like a little staircase.
cues.zh: 然後在最後，我會把它踢到高速檔，就像一個小樓梯一樣。

cues.text: How hard could it be to walk up the stairs?
cues.en: How hard could it be to walk up the stairs?
cues.zh: 走上樓梯有多難？

cues.text: No big deal, right?
cues.en: No big deal, right?
cues.zh: 沒什麼大不了的，對吧？

cues.text: But then, the funniest thing happened.
cues.en: But then, the funniest thing happened.
cues.zh: 但隨後，最有趣的事情發生了。

cues.text: Those first few months?
cues.en: Those first few months?
cues.zh: 最初幾個月？

cues.text: They came and went, and I couldn't quite do stuff.
cues.en: They came and went, and I couldn't quite do stuff.
cues.zh: 他們來來去去，我卻無能為力。

cues.text: So we had an awesome new revised plan.
cues.en: So we had an awesome new revised plan.
cues.zh: 所以我們有一個很棒的新修訂計劃。

cues.text: And then -- But then those middle months actually went by,
cues.en: And then -- But then those middle months actually went by,
cues.zh: 然後——但是中間的幾個月實際上過去了，

cues.text: and I didn't really write words, and so we were here.
cues.en: and I didn't really write words, and so we were here.
cues.zh: 我並沒有真正寫下文字，所以我們就在這裡。

cues.text: And then two months turned into one month, which turned into two weeks.
cues.en: And then two months turned into one month, which turned into two weeks.
cues.zh: 然後兩個月變成了一個月，又變成兩週了。

cues.text: And one day I woke up with three days until the deadline,
cues.en: And one day I woke up with three days until the deadline,
cues.zh: 有一天，我醒來，距離截止日期還有三天，

cues.text: still not having written a word, and so I did the only thing I could:
cues.en: still not having written a word, and so I did the only thing I could:
cues.zh: 仍然沒有寫出一個字，所以我做了我唯一能做的事：

cues.text: I wrote 90 pages over 72 hours, pulling not one but two all-nighters --
cues.en: I wrote 90 pages over 72 hours, pulling not one but two all-nighters --
cues.zh: 我在 72 小時內寫了 90 頁，不是一個而是兩個通宵——

cues.text: humans are not supposed to pull two all-nighters -- sprinted across campus,
cues.en: humans are not supposed to pull two all-nighters -- sprinted across campus,
cues.zh: 人類不該撐兩個通宵──衝刺穿過校園，

cues.text: dove in slow motion, and got it in just at the deadline.
cues.en: dove in slow motion, and got it in just at the deadline.
cues.zh: 慢動作地投入，並在截止日期前完成。

cues.text: I thought that was the end of everything.
cues.en: I thought that was the end of everything.
cues.zh: 我以為一切就這樣結束了。

cues.text: But a week later I get a call, and it's the school.
cues.en: But a week later I get a call, and it's the school.
cues.zh: 但一週後我接到電話，是學校打來的。

cues.text: And they say, "Is this Tim Urban?" And I say, "Yeah." And they say, "We need to talk about your thesis."
cues.en: And they say, "Is this Tim Urban?" And I say, "Yeah." And they say, "We need to talk about your thesis."
cues.zh: 他們說：“這是蒂姆·厄本嗎？”我說：“是的。”他們說：“我們需要談談你的論文。”

cues.text: And I say, "OK." And they say, "It's the best one we've ever seen."
cues.en: And I say, "OK." And they say, "It's the best one we've ever seen."
cues.zh: 我說：“好吧。”他們說：“這是我們見過的最好的一個。”

cues.text: That did not happen.
cues.en: That did not happen.
cues.zh: 但那並沒有發生。

cues.text: It was a very, very bad thesis.
cues.en: It was a very, very bad thesis.
cues.zh: 這是一篇非常非常糟糕的論文。

cues.text: I just wanted to enjoy that one moment when all of you thought,
cues.en: I just wanted to enjoy that one moment when all of you thought,
cues.zh: 我只是想享受那一刻，當你們都在想，

cues.text: "This guy is amazing!" No, it was very, very bad.
cues.en: "This guy is amazing!" No, it was very, very bad.
cues.zh: 「這傢伙太厲害了！」不，這非常非常糟糕。

cues.text: Anyway, today I'm a writer-blogger guy.
cues.en: Anyway, today I'm a writer-blogger guy.
cues.zh: 不管怎樣，今天我是一個作家兼部落客。

cues.text: I write the blog Wait But Why.
cues.en: I write the blog Wait But Why.
cues.zh: 我寫了部落格「Wait But Why」。

cues.text: And a couple of years ago, I decided to write about procrastination.
cues.en: And a couple of years ago, I decided to write about procrastination.
cues.zh: 幾年前，我決定寫一篇關於拖延症的文章。

cues.text: My behavior has always perplexed the non-procrastinators around me, and I wanted to explain to the non-procrastinators of the world
cues.en: My behavior has always perplexed the non-procrastinators around me, and I wanted to explain to the non-procrastinators of the world
cues.zh: 我的行為一直讓我周圍的非拖延者感到困惑，我想向全世界的非拖延者解釋

cues.text: what goes on in the heads of procrastinators, and why we are the way we are.
cues.en: what goes on in the heads of procrastinators, and why we are the way we are.
cues.zh: 拖延者的腦子裡在想什麼，為什麼我們會變成現在這個樣子。

cues.text: Now, I had a hypothesis that the brains of procrastinators were actually different
cues.en: Now, I had a hypothesis that the brains of procrastinators were actually different
cues.zh: 現在，我有一個假設：拖延者的大腦實際上是不同的

cues.text: than the brains of other people.
cues.en: than the brains of other people.
cues.zh: 比其他人的大腦。

cues.text: And to test this, I found an MRI lab that actually let me scan both my brain
cues.en: And to test this, I found an MRI lab that actually let me scan both my brain
cues.zh: 為了測試這一點，我找到了一個 MRI 實驗室，它實際上可以讓我掃描我的大腦

cues.text: and the brain of a proven non-procrastinator, so I could compare them.
cues.en: and the brain of a proven non-procrastinator, so I could compare them.
cues.zh: 以及一個被證明不拖延的人的大腦，這樣我就可以對它們進行比較。

cues.text: I actually brought them here to show you today.
cues.en: I actually brought them here to show you today.
cues.zh: 我今天實際上把它們帶到這裡來給你們看。

cues.text: I want you to take a look carefully to see if you can notice a difference.
cues.en: I want you to take a look carefully to see if you can notice a difference.
cues.zh: 我希望你仔細看一下，看看你是否能注意到差異。

cues.text: I know that if you're not a trained brain expert, it's not that obvious, but just take a look, OK?
cues.en: I know that if you're not a trained brain expert, it's not that obvious, but just take a look, OK?
cues.zh: 我知道，如果你不是受過訓練的大腦專家，這不是那麼明顯，但看看吧，好嗎？

cues.text: So here's the brain of a non-procrastinator.
cues.en: So here's the brain of a non-procrastinator.
cues.zh: 這是一個不拖延者的大腦。

cues.text: Now ...
cues.en: Now ...
cues.zh: 現在...

cues.text: here's my brain.
cues.en: here's my brain.
cues.zh: 這是我的大腦。

cues.text: There is a difference.
cues.en: There is a difference.
cues.zh: 有一個區別。

cues.text: Both brains have a Rational Decision-Maker in them, but the procrastinator's brain
cues.en: Both brains have a Rational Decision-Maker in them, but the procrastinator's brain
cues.zh: 兩個大腦中都有一個理性決策者，但拖延者的大腦

cues.text: also has an Instant Gratification Monkey.
cues.en: also has an Instant Gratification Monkey.
cues.zh: 還有一隻即時滿足猴。

cues.text: Now, what does this mean for the procrastinator?
cues.en: Now, what does this mean for the procrastinator?
cues.zh: 現在，這對拖延者意味著什麼？

cues.text: Well, it means everything's fine until this happens.
cues.en: Well, it means everything's fine until this happens.
cues.zh: 嗯，這意味著在這件事發生之前一切都很好。

cues.text: So the Rational Decision-Maker will make the rational decision to do something productive,
cues.en: So the Rational Decision-Maker will make the rational decision to do something productive,
cues.zh: 所以理性決策者會做出理性的決定去做一些有成效的事情，

cues.text: but the Monkey doesn't like that plan, so he actually takes the wheel, and he says, "Actually, let's read the entire Wikipedia page
cues.en: but the Monkey doesn't like that plan, so he actually takes the wheel, and he says, "Actually, let's read the entire Wikipedia page
cues.zh: 但猴子不喜歡這個計劃，所以他實際上掌握了方向盤，他說：「實際上，讓我們閱讀整個維基百科頁面

cues.text: of the Nancy Kerrigan/ Tonya Harding scandal, because I just remembered that happened.
cues.en: of the Nancy Kerrigan/ Tonya Harding scandal, because I just remembered that happened.
cues.zh: 南希·克里根/託尼亞·哈丁醜聞，因為我剛剛記得發生過那件事。

cues.text: Then -- Then we're going to go over to the fridge,
cues.en: Then -- Then we're going to go over to the fridge,
cues.zh: 然後--然後我們要去冰箱那兒，

cues.text: to see if there's anything new in there since 10 minutes ago.
cues.en: to see if there's anything new in there since 10 minutes ago.
cues.zh: 看看自 10 分鐘前以來是否有任何新內容。

cues.text: After that, we're going to go on a YouTube spiral that starts with videos of Richard Feynman talking about magnets
cues.en: After that, we're going to go on a YouTube spiral that starts with videos of Richard Feynman talking about magnets
cues.zh: 之後，我們將進入 YouTube 螺旋，從理查德費曼 (Richard Feynman) 談論磁鐵的影片開始

cues.text: and ends much, much later with us watching interviews with Justin Bieber's mom.
cues.en: and ends much, much later with us watching interviews with Justin Bieber's mom.
cues.zh: 很久很久以後，我們才看到賈斯汀·比伯媽媽的訪問。

cues.text: "All of that's going to take a while, so we're not going to really have room on the schedule for any work today.
cues.en: "All of that's going to take a while, so we're not going to really have room on the schedule for any work today.
cues.zh: 「所有這些都需要一段時間，所以我們今天的日程安排上不會有真正的空間來進行任何工作。

cues.text: Sorry!" Now, what is going on here?
cues.en: Sorry!" Now, what is going on here?
cues.zh: 對不起！ 「現在，這是怎麼回事？

cues.text: The Instant Gratification Monkey does not seem like a guy you want behind the wheel.
cues.en: The Instant Gratification Monkey does not seem like a guy you want behind the wheel.
cues.zh: 即時滿足猴子看起來不像是你想要的駕駛者。

cues.text: He lives entirely in the present moment.
cues.en: He lives entirely in the present moment.
cues.zh: 他完全活在當下。

cues.text: He has no memory of the past, no knowledge of the future, and he only cares about two things:
cues.en: He has no memory of the past, no knowledge of the future, and he only cares about two things:
cues.zh: 他對過去沒有記憶，對未來一無所知，他只關心兩件事：

cues.text: easy and fun.
cues.en: easy and fun.
cues.zh: 簡單又有趣。

cues.text: Now, in the animal world, that works fine.
cues.en: Now, in the animal world, that works fine.
cues.zh: 現在，在動物世界中，這很有效。

cues.text: If you're a dog and you spend your whole life doing nothing other than easy and fun things,
cues.en: If you're a dog and you spend your whole life doing nothing other than easy and fun things,
cues.zh: 如果你是一隻狗，一生只做簡單有趣的事情，

cues.text: you're a huge success!
cues.en: you're a huge success!
cues.zh: 你取得了巨大的成功！

cues.text: And to the Monkey, humans are just another animal species.
cues.en: And to the Monkey, humans are just another animal species.
cues.zh: 對猴子來說，人類只是另一種動物。

cues.text: You have to keep well-slept, well-fed and propagating into the next generation,
cues.en: You have to keep well-slept, well-fed and propagating into the next generation,
cues.zh: 你必須保持良好的睡眠、良好的飲食並繁衍下一代，

cues.text: which in tribal times might have worked OK.
cues.en: which in tribal times might have worked OK.
cues.zh: 這在部落時代可能行得通。

cues.text: But, if you haven't noticed, now we're not in tribal times.
cues.en: But, if you haven't noticed, now we're not in tribal times.
cues.zh: 但是，如果你沒有註意到，現在我們並不是處於部落時代。

cues.text: We're in an advanced civilization, and the Monkey does not know what that is.
cues.en: We're in an advanced civilization, and the Monkey does not know what that is.
cues.zh: 我們處在一個先進的文明中，而猴子不知道那是什麼。

cues.text: Which is why we have another guy in our brain, the Rational Decision-Maker,
cues.en: Which is why we have another guy in our brain, the Rational Decision-Maker,
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我們的大腦中有另一個人，理性決策者，

cues.text: who gives us the ability to do things no other animal can do.
cues.en: who gives us the ability to do things no other animal can do.
cues.zh: 他賦予我們做其他動物做不到的事情的能力。

cues.text: We can visualize the future.
cues.en: We can visualize the future.
cues.zh: 我們可以想像未來。

cues.text: We can see the big picture.
cues.en: We can see the big picture.
cues.zh: 我們可以看到大局。

cues.text: We can make long-term plans.
cues.en: We can make long-term plans.
cues.zh: 我們可以製定長期計劃。

cues.text: And he wants to take all of that into account.
cues.en: And he wants to take all of that into account.
cues.zh: 他想把所有這些都考慮在內。

cues.text: And he wants to just have us do whatever makes sense to be doing right now.
cues.en: And he wants to just have us do whatever makes sense to be doing right now.
cues.zh: 他想讓我們做任何現在有意義的事。

cues.text: Now, sometimes it makes sense to be doing things that are easy and fun, like when you're having dinner or going to bed
cues.en: Now, sometimes it makes sense to be doing things that are easy and fun, like when you're having dinner or going to bed
cues.zh: 現在，有時做一些簡單有趣的事情是有意義的，例如當你吃晚餐或睡覺時

cues.text: or enjoying well-earned leisure time.
cues.en: or enjoying well-earned leisure time.
cues.zh: 或享受應得的休閒時間。

cues.text: That's why there's an overlap.
cues.en: That's why there's an overlap.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼會有重疊。

cues.text: Sometimes they agree.
cues.en: Sometimes they agree.
cues.zh: 有時他們會同意。

cues.text: But other times, it makes much more sense to be doing things that are harder and less pleasant,
cues.en: But other times, it makes much more sense to be doing things that are harder and less pleasant,
cues.zh: 但其他時候，做更困難、更不愉快的事情更有意義，

cues.text: for the sake of the big picture.
cues.en: for the sake of the big picture.
cues.zh: 為了大局。

cues.text: And that's when we have a conflict.
cues.en: And that's when we have a conflict.
cues.zh: 這就是我們發生衝突的時候。

cues.text: And for the procrastinator, that conflict tends to end a certain way every time,
cues.en: And for the procrastinator, that conflict tends to end a certain way every time,
cues.zh: 對於拖延者來說，這種衝突每次都會以某種方式結束，

cues.text: leaving him spending a lot of time in this orange zone,
cues.en: leaving him spending a lot of time in this orange zone,
cues.zh: 讓他花了很多時間在這個橙色區域，

cues.text: an easy and fun place that's entirely out of the Makes Sense circle.
cues.en: an easy and fun place that's entirely out of the Makes Sense circle.
cues.zh: 一個簡單又有趣的地方，完全脫離了「有意義」的圈子。

cues.text: I call it the Dark Playground.
cues.en: I call it the Dark Playground.
cues.zh: 我稱之為黑暗遊樂場。

cues.text: Now, the Dark Playground is a place that all of you procrastinators out there know very well.
cues.en: Now, the Dark Playground is a place that all of you procrastinators out there know very well.
cues.zh: 現在，黑暗遊樂場是你們所有拖延者都非常熟悉的地方。

cues.text: It's where leisure activities happen at times when leisure activities are not supposed to be happening.
cues.en: It's where leisure activities happen at times when leisure activities are not supposed to be happening.
cues.zh: 這是在不應該進行休閒活動的時候進行休閒活動的地方。

cues.text: The fun you have in the Dark Playground isn't actually fun, because it's completely unearned,
cues.en: The fun you have in the Dark Playground isn't actually fun, because it's completely unearned,
cues.zh: 你在黑暗遊樂場中獲得的樂趣實際上並不有趣，因為它完全是不勞而獲的，

cues.text: and the air is filled with guilt, dread, anxiety, self-hatred -- all of those good procrastinator feelings.
cues.en: and the air is filled with guilt, dread, anxiety, self-hatred -- all of those good procrastinator feelings.
cues.zh: 空氣中充滿了內疚、恐懼、焦慮、自我憎恨——所有這些都是拖延者的良好感受。

cues.text: And the question is, in this situation, with the Monkey behind the wheel, how does the procrastinator ever get himself over here to this blue zone,
cues.en: And the question is, in this situation, with the Monkey behind the wheel, how does the procrastinator ever get himself over here to this blue zone,
cues.zh: 問題是，在這種情況下，猴子在開車，拖延者如何讓自己到達這個藍色區域，

cues.text: a less pleasant place, but where really important things happen?
cues.en: a less pleasant place, but where really important things happen?
cues.zh: 一個不太令人愉快的地方，但真正重要的事情發生在哪裡？

cues.text: Well, turns out the procrastinator has a guardian angel,
cues.en: Well, turns out the procrastinator has a guardian angel,
cues.zh: 原來拖延症患者有一個守護天使，

cues.text: someone who's always looking down on him and watching over him in his darkest moments --
cues.en: someone who's always looking down on him and watching over him in his darkest moments --
cues.zh: 一個總是在他最黑暗的時刻看不起他並守護他的人——

cues.text: someone called the Panic Monster.
cues.en: someone called the Panic Monster.
cues.zh: 有人稱為恐慌怪物。

cues.text: Now, the Panic Monster is dormant most of the time,
cues.en: Now, the Panic Monster is dormant most of the time,
cues.zh: 現在，恐慌怪物大部分時間都處於休眠狀態，

cues.text: but he suddenly wakes up anytime a deadline gets too close
cues.en: but he suddenly wakes up anytime a deadline gets too close
cues.zh: 但每當截止日期臨近時他就會突然醒來

cues.text: or there's danger of public embarrassment, a career disaster or some other scary consequence.
cues.en: or there's danger of public embarrassment, a career disaster or some other scary consequence.
cues.zh: 或有公眾尷尬、職業災難或其他可怕後果的危險。

cues.text: And importantly, he's the only thing the Monkey is terrified of.
cues.en: And importantly, he's the only thing the Monkey is terrified of.
cues.zh: 重要的是，他是猴子唯一害怕的東西。

cues.text: Now, he became very relevant in my life pretty recently,
cues.en: Now, he became very relevant in my life pretty recently,
cues.zh: 現在，他最近在我的生活中變得非常重要，

cues.text: because the people of TED reached out to me about six months ago and invited me to do a TED Talk.
cues.en: because the people of TED reached out to me about six months ago and invited me to do a TED Talk.
cues.zh: 因為大約六個月前 TED 的人聯絡了我並邀請我做一場 TED 演講。

cues.text: Now, of course, I said yes.
cues.en: Now, of course, I said yes.
cues.zh: 現在，我當然答應了。

cues.text: It's always been a dream of mine to have done a TED Talk in the past.
cues.en: It's always been a dream of mine to have done a TED Talk in the past.
cues.zh: 參加 TED 演講一直是我的夢想。

cues.text: But in the middle of all this excitement, the Rational Decision-Maker seemed to have something else on his mind.
cues.en: But in the middle of all this excitement, the Rational Decision-Maker seemed to have something else on his mind.
cues.zh: 但在這一切興奮之中，理性決策者似乎有別的想法。

cues.text: He was saying, "Are we clear on what we just accepted?
cues.en: He was saying, "Are we clear on what we just accepted?
cues.zh: 他說：「我們清楚我們剛剛接受的是什麼嗎？

cues.text: Do we get what's going to be now happening one day in the future?
cues.en: Do we get what's going to be now happening one day in the future?
cues.zh: 我們知道未來某一天會發生什麼事嗎？

cues.text: We need to sit down and work on this right now." And the Monkey said, "Totally agree, but let's just open Google Earth
cues.en: We need to sit down and work on this right now." And the Monkey said, "Totally agree, but let's just open Google Earth
cues.zh: 我們現在需要坐下來解決這個問題。猴子說：「完全同意，但我們開啟 Google 地球吧

cues.text: and zoom in to the bottom of India, like 200 feet above the ground, and scroll up for two and a half hours til we get to the top of the country,
cues.en: and zoom in to the bottom of India, like 200 feet above the ground, and scroll up for two and a half hours til we get to the top of the country,
cues.zh: 放大到印度的底部，距離地面 200 英尺，然後向上滾動兩個半小時，直到我們到達該國的頂部，

cues.text: so we can get a better feel for India." So that's what we did that day.
cues.en: so we can get a better feel for India." So that's what we did that day.
cues.zh: 這樣我們就能更瞭解印度。 」這就是我們那天所做的。

cues.text: As six months turned into four and then two and then one,
cues.en: As six months turned into four and then two and then one,
cues.zh: 六個月變成了四個月，然後兩個月，然後一個月，

cues.text: the people of TED decided to release the speakers.
cues.en: the people of TED decided to release the speakers.
cues.zh: TED 的人們決定釋放演講者。

cues.text: And I opened up the website, and there was my face staring right back at me.
cues.en: And I opened up the website, and there was my face staring right back at me.
cues.zh: 我開啟了網站，我的臉正盯著我。

cues.text: And guess who woke up?
cues.en: And guess who woke up?
cues.zh: 猜猜誰醒了？

cues.text: So the Panic Monster starts losing his mind, and a few seconds later, the whole system's in mayhem.
cues.en: So the Panic Monster starts losing his mind, and a few seconds later, the whole system's in mayhem.
cues.zh: 於是恐慌怪物開始失去理智，幾秒鐘後，整個系統陷入混亂。

cues.text: And the Monkey -- remember, he's terrified of the Panic Monster -- boom, he's up the tree!
cues.en: And the Monkey -- remember, he's terrified of the Panic Monster -- boom, he's up the tree!
cues.zh: 還有猴子——記住，他害怕恐慌怪物——砰，他爬上了樹！

cues.text: And finally, finally, the Rational Decision-Maker can take the wheel
cues.en: And finally, finally, the Rational Decision-Maker can take the wheel
cues.zh: 最後，最後，理性決策者可以掌舵

cues.text: and I can start working on the talk.
cues.en: and I can start working on the talk.
cues.zh: 我可以開始準備演講了。

cues.text: Now, the Panic Monster explains all kinds of pretty insane procrastinator behavior,
cues.en: Now, the Panic Monster explains all kinds of pretty insane procrastinator behavior,
cues.zh: 現在，恐慌怪物解釋了各種相當瘋狂的拖延者行為，

cues.text: like how someone like me could spend two weeks unable to start the opening sentence of a paper,
cues.en: like how someone like me could spend two weeks unable to start the opening sentence of a paper,
cues.zh: 就像像我這樣的人可能會花兩週時間無法開始一篇論文的開頭句，

cues.text: and then miraculously find the unbelievable work ethic to stay up all night and write eight pages.
cues.en: and then miraculously find the unbelievable work ethic to stay up all night and write eight pages.
cues.zh: 然後奇蹟般地找到了令人難以置信的職業道德，熬夜寫了八頁。

cues.text: And this entire situation, with the three characters -- this is the procrastinator's system.
cues.en: And this entire situation, with the three characters -- this is the procrastinator's system.
cues.zh: 整個情況，有三個特點──這就是拖延者的系統。

cues.text: It's not pretty, but in the end, it works.
cues.en: It's not pretty, but in the end, it works.
cues.zh: 它並不漂亮，但最終還是有效的。

cues.text: This is what I decided to write about on the blog a couple of years ago.
cues.en: This is what I decided to write about on the blog a couple of years ago.
cues.zh: 這是我幾年前決定在部落格上寫的內容。

cues.text: When I did, I was amazed by the response.
cues.en: When I did, I was amazed by the response.
cues.zh: 當我這樣做時，我對反應感到驚訝。

cues.text: Literally thousands of emails came in, from all different kinds of people from all over the world,
cues.en: Literally thousands of emails came in, from all different kinds of people from all over the world,
cues.zh: 從字面上看，來自世界各地不同型別的人收到了數千封電子郵件，

cues.text: doing all different kinds of things.
cues.en: doing all different kinds of things.
cues.zh: 做各種不同的事情。

cues.text: These are people who were nurses, bankers, painters, engineers and lots and lots of PhD students.
cues.en: These are people who were nurses, bankers, painters, engineers and lots and lots of PhD students.
cues.zh: 這些人是護士、銀行家、畫家、工程師和許許多多的博士生。

cues.text: And they were all writing, saying the same thing: "I have this problem too."
cues.en: And they were all writing, saying the same thing: "I have this problem too."
cues.zh: 他們都在寫信，說著同樣的話：“我也有這個問題。”

cues.text: But what struck me was the contrast between the light tone of the post
cues.en: But what struck me was the contrast between the light tone of the post
cues.zh: 但令我印象深刻的是貼文的淺色調之間的對比

cues.text: and the heaviness of these emails.
cues.en: and the heaviness of these emails.
cues.zh: 以及這些電子郵件的沉重。

cues.text: These people were writing with intense frustration about what procrastination had done to their lives,
cues.en: These people were writing with intense frustration about what procrastination had done to their lives,
cues.zh: 這些人帶著強烈的挫折感寫下了拖延症對他們生活造成的影響，

cues.text: about what this Monkey had done to them.
cues.en: about what this Monkey had done to them.
cues.zh: 關於這隻猴子對他們做了什麼。

cues.text: And I thought about this, and I said, well, if the procrastinator's system works, then what's going on?
cues.en: And I thought about this, and I said, well, if the procrastinator's system works, then what's going on?
cues.zh: 我想了想，我說，好吧，如果拖延者的系統有效，那麼會發生什麼事？

cues.text: Why are all of these people in such a dark place?
cues.en: Why are all of these people in such a dark place?
cues.zh: 為什麼這些人都在這麼黑暗的地方？

cues.text: Well, it turns out that there's two kinds of procrastination.
cues.en: Well, it turns out that there's two kinds of procrastination.
cues.zh: 嗯，事實證明，拖延有兩種。

cues.text: Everything I've talked about today, the examples I've given, they all have deadlines.
cues.en: Everything I've talked about today, the examples I've given, they all have deadlines.
cues.zh: 我今天談到的所有內容，我給的例子，它們都有截止日期。

cues.text: And when there's deadlines, the effects of procrastination are contained to the short term
cues.en: And when there's deadlines, the effects of procrastination are contained to the short term
cues.zh: 當有最後期限時，拖延的影響就會被限制在短期內

cues.text: because the Panic Monster gets involved.
cues.en: because the Panic Monster gets involved.
cues.zh: 因為恐慌怪物介入了。

cues.text: But there's a second kind of procrastination that happens in situations when there is no deadline.
cues.en: But there's a second kind of procrastination that happens in situations when there is no deadline.
cues.zh: 但第二種拖延是在沒有最後期限的情況下發生的。

cues.text: So if you wanted a career where you're a self-starter -- something in the arts, something entrepreneurial --
cues.en: So if you wanted a career where you're a self-starter -- something in the arts, something entrepreneurial --
cues.zh: 因此，如果你想要一份能夠自我啟動的職業——藝術方面的，創業方面的——

cues.text: there's no deadlines on those things at first, because nothing's happening,
cues.en: there's no deadlines on those things at first, because nothing's happening,
cues.zh: 這些事情一開始就沒有最後期限，因為什麼事都沒有發生，

cues.text: not until you've gone out and done the hard work to get momentum, get things going.
cues.en: not until you've gone out and done the hard work to get momentum, get things going.
cues.zh: 直到你走出去並完成艱苦的工作來獲得動力，讓事情繼續下去。

cues.text: There's also all kinds of important things outside of your career that don't involve any deadlines,
cues.en: There's also all kinds of important things outside of your career that don't involve any deadlines,
cues.zh: 還有你職業生涯以外的各種重要的事情，不涉及任何截止日期，

cues.text: like seeing your family or exercising and taking care of your health, working on your relationship
cues.en: like seeing your family or exercising and taking care of your health, working on your relationship
cues.zh: 例如探望家人、運動、照顧健康、改善人際關係

cues.text: or getting out of a relationship that isn't working.
cues.en: or getting out of a relationship that isn't working.
cues.zh: 或擺脫一段無效的關係。

cues.text: Now if the procrastinator's only mechanism of doing these hard things
cues.en: Now if the procrastinator's only mechanism of doing these hard things
cues.zh: 現在，如果拖延者做這些困難事情的唯一機制

cues.text: is the Panic Monster, that's a problem, because in all of these non-deadline situations,
cues.en: is the Panic Monster, that's a problem, because in all of these non-deadline situations,
cues.zh: 是恐慌怪物，這是一個問題，因為在所有這些非最後期限的情況下，

cues.text: the Panic Monster doesn't show up.
cues.en: the Panic Monster doesn't show up.
cues.zh: 恐慌怪物沒有出現。

cues.text: He has nothing to wake up for, so the effects of procrastination, they're not contained;
cues.en: He has nothing to wake up for, so the effects of procrastination, they're not contained;
cues.zh: 他沒有什麼值得醒來的，所以拖延的影響並沒有得到控制；

cues.text: they just extend outward forever.
cues.en: they just extend outward forever.
cues.zh: 它們只是永遠向外延伸。

cues.text: And it's this long-term kind of procrastination that's much less visible and much less talked about
cues.en: And it's this long-term kind of procrastination that's much less visible and much less talked about
cues.zh: 而這種長期的拖延卻不太明顯，也很少被談論。

cues.text: than the funnier, short-term deadline-based kind.
cues.en: than the funnier, short-term deadline-based kind.
cues.zh: 比更有趣、基於截止日期的短期型別。

cues.text: It's usually suffered quietly and privately.
cues.en: It's usually suffered quietly and privately.
cues.zh: 它通常是悄悄地、私下遭受的。

cues.text: And it can be the source of a huge amount of long-term unhappiness, and regrets.
cues.en: And it can be the source of a huge amount of long-term unhappiness, and regrets.
cues.zh: 它可能是大量長期不快樂和遺憾的根源。

cues.text: And I thought, that's why those people are emailing, and that's why they're in such a bad place.
cues.en: And I thought, that's why those people are emailing, and that's why they're in such a bad place.
cues.zh: 我想，這就是那些人發電子郵件的原因，也是他們處境如此糟糕的原因。

cues.text: It's not that they're cramming for some project.
cues.en: It's not that they're cramming for some project.
cues.zh: 這並不是說他們為了某個專案而臨時抱佛腳。

cues.text: It's that long-term procrastination has made them feel like a spectator, at times, in their own lives.
cues.en: It's that long-term procrastination has made them feel like a spectator, at times, in their own lives.
cues.zh: 長期的拖延讓他們有時覺得自己是自己生命中的旁觀者。

cues.text: The frustration is not that they couldn't achieve their dreams; it's that they weren't even able to start chasing them.
cues.en: The frustration is not that they couldn't achieve their dreams; it's that they weren't even able to start chasing them.
cues.zh: 挫折感並不是他們無法實現自己的夢想，而是他們無法實現自己的夢想。而是他們根本就沒有能力去追趕他們。

cues.text: So I read these emails and I had a little bit of an epiphany --
cues.en: So I read these emails and I had a little bit of an epiphany --
cues.zh: 所以我讀了這些電子郵件，我頓悟了——

cues.text: that I don't think non-procrastinators exist.
cues.en: that I don't think non-procrastinators exist.
cues.zh: 我認為不拖延者不存在。

cues.text: That's right -- I think all of you are procrastinators.
cues.en: That's right -- I think all of you are procrastinators.
cues.zh: 是的──我認為你們都是拖延者。

cues.text: Now, you might not all be a mess, like some of us, and some of you may have a healthy relationship with deadlines,
cues.en: Now, you might not all be a mess, like some of us, and some of you may have a healthy relationship with deadlines,
cues.zh: 現在，你們可能不像我們中的一些人那樣一團糟，而且你們中的一些人可能與截止日期有著健康的關係，

cues.text: but remember: the Monkey's sneakiest trick is when the deadlines aren't there.
cues.en: but remember: the Monkey's sneakiest trick is when the deadlines aren't there.
cues.zh: 但請記住：猴子最狡猾的伎倆是在沒有最後期限的時候。

cues.text: Now, I want to show you one last thing.
cues.en: Now, I want to show you one last thing.
cues.zh: 現在，我想向您展示最後一件事。

cues.text: I call this a Life Calendar.
cues.en: I call this a Life Calendar.
cues.zh: 我稱之為生活日曆。

cues.text: That's one box for every week of a 90-year life.
cues.en: That's one box for every week of a 90-year life.
cues.zh: 這相當於 90 歲人生中每週一盒的用量。

cues.text: That's not that many boxes, especially since we've already used a bunch of those.
cues.en: That's not that many boxes, especially since we've already used a bunch of those.
cues.zh: 盒子不多，尤其是我們已經用了很多了。

cues.text: So I think we need to all take a long, hard look at that calendar.
cues.en: So I think we need to all take a long, hard look at that calendar.
cues.zh: 所以我認為我們都需要仔細檢視這份日曆。

cues.text: We need to think about what we're really procrastinating on, because everyone is procrastinating on something in life.
cues.en: We need to think about what we're really procrastinating on, because everyone is procrastinating on something in life.
cues.zh: 我們需要思考我們真正在拖延什麼，因為每個人都在生活中拖延某些事情。

cues.text: We need to stay aware of the Instant Gratification Monkey.
cues.en: We need to stay aware of the Instant Gratification Monkey.
cues.zh: 我們需要警惕即時滿足猴。

cues.text: That's a job for all of us.
cues.en: That's a job for all of us.
cues.zh: 這是我們所有人的工作。

cues.text: And because there's not that many boxes on there, it's a job that should probably start today.
cues.en: And because there's not that many boxes on there, it's a job that should probably start today.
cues.zh: 因為那裡沒有那麼多盒子，所以這項工作可能應該從今天開始。

cues.text: Well, maybe not today, but ...
cues.en: Well, maybe not today, but ...
cues.zh: 好吧，也許不是今天，但......

cues.text: You know.
cues.en: You know.
cues.zh: 你知道。

cues.text: Sometime soon.
cues.en: Sometime soon.
cues.zh: 很快的某個時候。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。
